payload.name: ResolveRelativeTimeInExtraction
payload.description: When constructing a memory from a message containing a relative time expression and a message/session timestamp is available, resolve it to an absolute date during extraction.
content: During candidate extraction, if a message contains a relative time expression (e.g., 'yesterday', 'last week', 'last month', 'last year', 'two days ago'), resolve it to an absolute date using the message/session timestamp before forming the candidate.
Write the resolved absolute date in the memory content and in structured time fields such as world_start/world_end; do not substitute vague words like 'recently'.
If the timestamp is missing or the relative expression cannot be resolved, keep the original phrase and do not invent a specific date.

solves: Extraction failed when a relative time phrase such as 'last month' was stored as 'recently', losing the absolute date needed later. Resolve relative time expressions (yesterday, last week/month/year, two days ago) to absolute dates using the message/session timestamp during candidate extraction. This applies to future event-memory construction whenever such phrases appear and a timestamp exists; it does not apply when the timestamp is missing or the expression is intentionally vague.
